name: Yukinokouji Mizore
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy First Year
Class: Snow Fairy
[u]Babe Form Measurements[/u]
R Cup
Height: 160 cm
B114/W56/H88

A petite girl from the Snow Kingdom who studies at the Yggdrasil Girls' Magic Academy.  

Her [url=/c85375]mother[/url] is a famous figure skater, and Mizore is quite skilled on the blades herseff. Though she's a shy and quiet girl, she also has a competitive streak.

She tends to treat the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url] like a kid, although she despises being treated like one herself. Mizore has the ability to transform into her hot “babe form,” which is very effective in seducing the protagonist with her charms.  

She's usually seen dragging a snowman-shaped suitcase, though she doesn't seem to have any magical powers, and she merely uses it as a blunt weapon in battle
